item.title: Harrison Township supporting Clay Township
item.description: LEWISBURG — Harrison Township has issued a statement expressing support for neighboring Clay Township in Montgomery County regarding a proposed township division initiative being promoted by a group calling itself the “North West Initiative.” The post Harrison Township supporting Clay Township appeared first on The Register Herald.

item.title: Trustees to place fire, rescue levy on ballot
item.description: CLAY TOWNSHIP — The trustees voted Feb. 3 to place a 2.5-mill levy for fire and rescue service for the township on the May 5 ballot. The post Trustees to place fire, rescue levy on ballot appeared first on The Register Herald.

item.title: Creech to seek re-election to House
item.description: COLUMBUS — State Rep. Rodney Creech announced Friday, Feb. 6, he has filed for re-election to represent Ohio’s 40th House District, saying the bid would be his fourth and final term in the Ohio House. The post Creech to seek re-election to House appeared first on The Register Herald.
